post.description: Records what the gateway reported it settled for this store. The platform does not move this money (DEC-FIN-001): it records what happened and reconciles it against the ledger. Reporting the same provider reference twice records one settlement; reporting it with different amounts is refused, because two contradictory statements of fact are a reconciliation case rather than something to overwrite.
